definitions.explanation: Organic matter that has been decomposed and recycled as fertilizer for plants. Made from kitchen scraps, yard waste, and other organic materials.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生|なま}ゴミ→生ゴミ：08044_namagomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{堆肥|たいひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}っている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm making compost using food scraps.

examples.japanese: {堆肥|たいひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まいて→撒く：12711_maku⟧⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}かに→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I spread compost on the field to enrich the soil.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{堆肥|たいひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コンポスター→コンポスター：29842_konposutaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a composter to make compost at home.

notes:
RELATED TERMS:
・⟦コンポスト→コンポスト：29822_konposuto⟧: compost (loanword, sometimes used interchangeably)
・⟦{腐葉土|ふようど}→腐葉土：29593_fuyoudo⟧: leaf mold
・⟦{有機|ゆうき}{肥料|ひりょう}→有機肥料：26530_yuukihiryou⟧: organic fertilizer
・⟦{化学|かがく}{肥料|ひりょう}→化学肥料：17490_kagakuhiryou⟧: chemical fertilizer

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{堆肥|たいひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to make compost)
・{堆肥|たいひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まく→撒く：12711_maku⟧ (to spread compost)
・{堆肥|たいひ}⟦{置|お}き{場|ば}→置き場：22477_okiba⟧ (compost pile/area)

COMPOST INGREDIENTS IN JAPANESE:
・⟦{生|なま}ゴミ→生ゴミ：08044_namagomi⟧/⟦{台所|だいどころ}→台所：01021_daidokoro⟧⟦くず→屑：03883_kuzu⟧ (food scraps)
・⟦{落|お}ち{葉|ば}→落ち葉：14108_ochiba⟧ (fallen leaves)
・⟦{刈|か}り{草|くさ}→刈り草：noentry⟧ (grass clippings)
・⟦{枯|か}れ{枝|えだ}→枯れ枝：noentry⟧ (dead branches)

CULTURAL NOTE:
With Japan's emphasis on waste reduction and recycling, home composting (⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦{堆肥化|たいひか}→堆肥化：noentry⟧) has become more popular. Many municipalities encourage composting to reduce burnable waste.
